info.description:
The DingConnect mobile top-up API (Ding / Ezetop Unlimited Company, Dublin): catalogue discovery (countries, providers, products, promotions), account lookup, price estimation, and instant top-up transfers to 5B+ phones worldwide.

This definition was authored by Voxgig from DingConnect's public developer documentation (dingconnect.com/Api) and the community Go client vlab-research/go-dingconnect, because DingConnect's own swagger definition requires an API key to download. DingConnect's docs invite generating client SDKs from the swagger definition; replace this file with the first-party definition when a key is available.

Application-level failure is reported in the body with HTTP 200: ResultCode (1 success, 2 partial, 4 failed) is the real signal, with ErrorCodes enumerated by GetErrorCodeDescriptions.
